Hi Sana — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and a proposed path forward so we can align internally and surface the right stakeholders on your side.

Recap (30m call):
- Use case: real-time insight enrichment for model inference pipeline (low-latency, high-QPS bursts).
- Target SLA: 99.9% for inference latency < 120ms P95.
- Estimated monthly token volume: ~120M (pilot) -> 500M (Q1 production).
- Concern: procurement & legal vendor assessment timeline; budget decision currently under finance.

Ask from our side: can you confirm the economic buyer / budget owner and the procurement contact we should work through? If helpful, we can draft a short mutual action plan (MAP) for Priya/finance + procurement to review.

Proposed next steps (we suggest):
1) Intro email from you that loops in the budget owner (Priya?) and procurement (Mark/procurement@datagrid.ai).
2) Short 30-min alignment call with Priya + procurement to confirm budget window and procurement path (timeline, PO vs contract).
3) We’ll send a follow-up one-pager of pricing scenarios + a checklist of security/compliance artifacts (SOC2, data retention, contract redlines).

I attached an initial pricing options PDF to make the budget conversation concrete (DG_Pricing_Options_v1.pdf).

If you prefer, Ben can run a short technical call with Priya’s team to validate perf assumptions before budget asks.

Thanks — will move quickly if you can point us to the right econ/budget owner.

Best,
